text:
jamal: hey team — new hire here, running my first Buildkite pipeline but it's failing on the GitHub trigger with 403. who should I ping?
alex: hey jamal, can you paste the first error line? most likely the GitHub App install doesn't have workflows repo permission.
jamal: pasted log:
```
2026-11-05T14:12:03Z buildkite-agent: POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood/repo/actions/workflows/dispatches -> 403 Forbidden
{"message":"Resource not accessible by integration"}
```
alex: yep that JSON is the classic GH App perms. Check org settings and that the app is installed for this repo. Also check repo-level 'Actions' settings under Settings -> Actions.
sophia: also check whether your org enforces SSO/SAML. If the GitHub App isn't authorized for your org, installs can fail silently. Ping me if you don't have permissions to re-install.
jamal: where do I find the Buildkite -> GitHub App link?
alex: Buildkite UI -> Pipelines -> <your-pipeline> -> Settings -> Integrations -> GitHub. If it's connected there should be a link to the GitHub App. If not, click Connect.
maria: fyi if your job needs to push docker images later you will also need ECR creds in the pipeline env (AWS_ECR_LOGIN / ECR_REGISTRY). onboarding doc: https://redwood.dev/docs/ci-secrets :thumbsup:
jamal: ok reinstalled the GH App for the repo and retried, next error is docker pull unauthorized when runner tries to fetch base image:
```
Error response from daemon: pull access denied for private-base, repository does not exist or may require 'docker login'
```
alex: that means the pipeline runner lacks ECR/DockerHub auth. Either add AWS keys to pipeline secrets or ask infra to give the CI role ECR pull permissions. Quick workaround in a step:
```
- command: |
  aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin $ECR_REGISTRY
```
devex-bot: Thanks for asking! If you're onboarding, check the CI quickstart: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/ci and mention @devex for a walkthrough.
jamal: thanks all — re-ran with ECR creds from ops and the build passed. marking resolved :tada:
